summary: Stripe and Advent International have jointly approached PayPal Holdings (NasdaqGS:PYPL) with a takeover bid supported by substantial bank financing. The proposal aims to combine Stripe's business-focused payments network with PayPal's established consumer platform. Reports indicate PayPal has not engaged with the offer so far, leaving the outcome uncertain for shareholders and customers.
